message.content:
I paid $38 for this used mechanical keyboard, and I think I got about $38 worth of keyboard, maybe a little more.

The space bar rattles. Every thumb press gets a hollow clatter, like a tray of cutlery being nudged. I tune it out during the day, but after midnight I find myself typing around it. The "E" key also repeats now and then, so "meeting" turns into "meeeting." It happens maybe once every few paragraphs. That's rare enough to forget and frequent enough that I reread everything before hitting send.

I messaged the seller to ask what switches it used, got tired of waiting, and bought it anyway. The answer came a week later, after the keyboard was already on my desk. Brown switches, for the record.

The comfort is why I'm keeping it. Each key has a small bump partway down, so my fingers know a press registered without slamming to the bottom. I can get through a long email and my wrists feel fine afterward, which the flat laptop keys never managed.

I thought about sending it back. Return shipping would have eaten a real chunk of what I paid, and I'd be back on the laptop. So it stays, rattle and all.
